projects.name: LLM 效果评估体系（creative-eval）
projects.description: 短剧剧本质量的 LLM 打分裁判与可信度验证。五维评分 rubric，与人工标注 ±1 分一致率 93.1%，同输入连跑三次的加权标准差 0.074。
projects.descriptionEn: LLM-as-judge for short drama script quality. Five-dimension rubric, 93.1% ±1-point agreement with human labels, weighted std 0.074 across 3 runs.
projects.subtitle: 让"剧本好不好"变成一个可以被反驳的数字
projects.subtitleEn: Turning "is this script good" into a falsifiable number
projects.context: 短剧行业筛剧本靠制片人主观判断，同一个本子两个人能给出完全相反的结论，且无法复现。
projects.contextEn: Short-drama script screening relies on subjective judgment; two readers often reach opposite conclusions with no reproducibility.
approach: 拆出钩子强度、人物动机、冲突密度、节奏、爽点五个维度，每维写死分档锚点，消除"感觉不错"式打分
人工标注 40 条金标集做基线，用 ±1 分一致率检验 LLM 裁判是否可信
同一输入连跑三次算加权标准差，把"随机性"本身当成一个要压住的指标
approachEn: Decomposed into 5 dimensions with fixed scoring anchors to eliminate vibe-based grading
Hand-labeled a 40-sample golden set as baseline; validated the judge via ±1-point agreement
Ran identical inputs 3x and tracked weighted std — treating variance itself as a target metric
projects.result: 一致率 93.1%，标准差 0.074。结论是：这套裁判可以replace初筛，但不能replace终审 —— 这个边界写在 README 第一段。
projects.resultEn: 93.1% agreement, 0.074 std. Conclusion: the judge can replace first-pass screening but not final review — stated in the README opening.
projects.demoNote: Demo 以第二版 llm-output-eval 呈现

projects.name: llm-output-eval
projects.subtitle: 给长文本生成结果打分，并证明打分器本身可信
projects.subtitleEn: Score long-form LLM output, and prove the scorer itself can be trusted
projects.description: creative-eval 的第二版，把裁判做成可日常使用的工具：两版 prompt 各连跑 N 次做对比、低分维度自动收进 Bad Case 导出 CSV、每个分数附从原文逐字抽出的证据句。自带 API Key 即可跑真实评测，key 只留在浏览器。
projects.descriptionEn: Second iteration of creative-eval, turned into a daily tool: run two prompt versions N times each for comparison, auto-collect low-scoring dimensions into an exportable Bad Case list, and attach a verbatim evidence sentence to every score. Bring your own API key; it never leaves the browser.
projects.context: 做剧本创作 Agent 时，最难的不是让模型产出，而是判断「这一版比上一版好」。评审意见永远是「感觉不对」，没法量化、没法比较。但分数本身也会骗人——没校准的尺子量出来的数字看着像结论，其实是噪声。
projects.contextEn: Building a screenwriting agent, the hard part was never generation — it was judging whether this version beats the last. Review feedback was always 'feels off': unquantifiable, incomparable. But scores lie too; an uncalibrated ruler produces numbers that look like conclusions and are actually noise.
approach: 逐维打分而非总分：五个维度各写清 1–5 档的可观察行为，每个分数必须附原文逐字证据，非逐字的静默丢弃
版本对比：两版各独立连跑 N 次给均值 ± 极差，只有极差不重叠才敢说「更好」
裁判校验：30 条人工金标集跑三项检查，与人工标注的 Spearman ρ 0.93，MAE 0.26；同时如实记录 temperature 0 并不确定、pacing 维度最噪、以及三处差 2 分以上的原因（其中一处是作者自己标错）
approachEn: Per-dimension scoring, not a total: five dimensions with observable 1–5 anchors; every score must cite verbatim evidence, non-verbatim quotes are silently dropped
Version comparison: each version runs N times independently for mean ± range; 'better' is only claimed when ranges do not overlap

Judge validation: 30 hand-labelled samples through three checks — Spearman ρ 0.93 vs human, MAE 0.26 — while honestly recording that temperature 0 is not deterministic, pacing is the noisiest dimension, and the three ≥2-point gaps (one of which was the author's own labelling error)
projects.result: 结论是：裁判给文本排的顺序和人一致，但不能稳定落到同一个整数上。对「V2 比 V1 好吗」够用，对「这段是 4 分」不够用。这条边界写在 README 里，不藏。
projects.resultEn: The verdict: the judge orders texts the way a human does, but does not land on the same integer reliably. Good enough for 'is V2 better than V1', not for 'this is a 4'. That boundary is stated in the README, not hidden.

projects.name: LLM 效果评估体系（filing-eval）
projects.description: 公告摘要的事实核查评测。断言级比对，错误检出 11/11、误报 0/4、提示注入 5/5 守住。
projects.descriptionEn: Fact-checking eval for announcement summaries. Claim-level verification, 11/11 recall, 0/4 false positives, 5/5 prompt injection blocked.
projects.subtitle: 摘要是否忠于原文，逐条断言去对
projects.context: 模型给公告写摘要时会"顺口"加上原文没有的数字和因果，人工抽检成本高且抓不全。
projects.contextEn: Summarization models fabricate numbers and causal links absent from the source; manual spot checks are costly and incomplete.
approach: 把摘要切成原子断言，逐条回原文找证据，判定「支持 / 矛盾 / 无依据」
构造 4 条"看起来像错但其实对"的诱导样本，专门测误报
塞 5 条提示注入进原文，检验评测流程本身会不会被带跑
approachEn: Split summaries into atomic claims; verified each against the source as supported / contradicted / unsupported
Built 4 adversarial "looks-wrong-but-correct" cases to measure false positives
Injected 5 prompt-injection payloads into source docs to test harness robustness
projects.result: 错误检出 11/11，误报 0/4，注入 5/5 全部守住。误报为 0 这条比检出率更重要 —— 评测工具自己乱报警，就没人会用。
projects.resultEn: 11/11 recall, 0/4 false positives, 5/5 injections blocked. Zero false positives matters more than recall — a noisy eval tool gets abandoned.

projects.name: 百度文库命理馆
projects.description: 从 0 到 1 搭建 AI 命理产品，包含命理星盘、日运抽签、马年运势、缘分测算四大模块。DAU 破万、分享率 26%，通过数据埋点与 SQL 分析驱动迭代，模块 UV 提升 60%。

projects.context: 文库需要一个高频轻互动场景拉回访，命理是需求真实但供给极度同质化的品类。
projects.contextEn: Baidu Library needed a high-frequency light-interaction hook; fortune-telling had real demand but highly commoditized supply.
approach: 拆成命理星盘、日运抽签、马年运势、缘分测算四个模块，分别对应「一次性深度」和「每日轻回访」两种使用节奏
把结果做成可截图传播的视觉资产，而不是一段纯文字 —— 分享是这类产品最便宜的获客
全链路埋点后用 SQL 拆漏斗，发现入口曝光够但点击弱，改了入口文案与位置
approachEn: Four modules split across two usage rhythms: one-shot depth vs. daily light return
Made results screenshot-shareable visual assets rather than plain text — sharing is the cheapest acquisition here
Instrumented the full funnel, used SQL to isolate a weak-click / strong-impression entry, then reworked copy and placement
projects.result: DAU 破万，分享率 26%，改入口后模块 UV +60%。
projects.resultEn: 10k+ DAU, 26% share rate, +60% module UV after the entry rework.

projects.name: AI 定制壁纸玩法
projects.description: 基于用户年龄性别标签智能推荐动态/静态壁纸，将抽象运势转化为可传播的视觉资产，提升命理产品复访留存。支持多维度内容供给（全年开运、财运、事业运、爱情运）。
projects.descriptionEn: Smart wallpaper recommendation based on age/gender, turned abstract fortunes into shareable visual assets, improved retention. Multi-dimensional content (fortune, wealth, career, love).
projects.subtitle: 把抽象运势变成能带走的东西
projects.subtitleEn: Turning abstract fortunes into something you take with you
projects.context: 命理结果看完就走，缺一个把用户留在产品里的载体。
projects.contextEn: Fortune results were read once and forgotten — no artifact kept users coming back.
approach: 按年龄性别标签推荐动静态壁纸，避免所有人拿到同一张图
按全年开运 / 财运 / 事业 / 爱情四个维度切内容供给，覆盖不同诉求

projects.subtitle: 自己上线的小工具，从想法到域名全流程
projects.subtitleEn: A self-shipped tool — idea to live domain, end to end
projects.context: 牌桌上判断对手风格全靠感觉，新手连自己是什么打法都说不清。
projects.contextEn: Reading opponent styles is intuition-driven; beginners can't even articulate their own.
approach: 用 VPIP、激进度、粘性三个维度建模，这是扑克圈公认的判据而不是我自创的
分专业模式（带底池、位置、筹码深度）和简单模式，避免新手在第一题就被术语劝退
approachEn: Modeled on VPIP, aggression, and stickiness — the community-accepted axes, not invented ones
Pro mode (pot, position, stack depth) and simple mode, so beginners aren't bounced by jargon on question one
projects.result: 已上线可直接玩，小红书导流验证真实用户是否愿意做完 10 题。
projects.resultEn: Live and playable; drove traffic from RED to test whether real users finish all 10 questions.

projects.name: Growth Experiment Lab
projects.subtitle: A/B 实验的决策模拟器：样本量够不够、什么时候能停、这个提升值不值得全量
projects.subtitleEn: A decision simulator for A/B tests: is the sample enough, when to stop, is the lift worth shipping
projects.description: 把增长 PM 做实验时的三个判断做成可操作的工具。用蒙特卡洛模拟演示「每天偷看、一显著就停」会把假阳性率从 5% 推到 22.45%；结果解读器按置信区间下界折算最保守的月增量收入。
projects.descriptionEn: Turns the three judgement calls of running an A/B test into a hands-on tool. Monte Carlo shows how peeking daily inflates false positives from 5% to 22.45%; the interpreter converts the CI lower bound into a conservative monthly revenue estimate.
projects.context: 在美团做优惠券梯度的 A/B 验证时，难的不是跑实验，而是三件事：实验前算不清要多少样本；跑到一半看到数字好看想提前停；跑完了提升两个点，老板问这两个点值多少钱、置信不置信。这三件事都不是纯统计问题，而是统计结论如何变成当天的决策。
projects.contextEn: Running coupon A/B tests at Meituan, the hard part was never the test itself. It was three things: sizing the sample beforehand, resisting the urge to stop early when numbers looked good, and answering what a two-point lift is worth in money with what confidence. None of these are pure statistics — they are about turning a statistical result into a decision.
approach: 实验设计器：输入基线转化率、MDE、α、power、日流量，输出每组样本量与所需天数，并支持反推「只肯跑 7 天能检出多少」
偷看惩罚模拟器：在两组真实转化率完全相同的前提下，用蒙特卡洛跑四种检查策略，直接展示假阳性率的差异
结果解读器：给 p 值、置信区间和三档结论，再按区间上下界折算月增量收入，回答「最保守能拿多少」
approachEn: Designer: baseline rate, MDE, α, power and daily traffic in; per-arm sample size and duration out, plus a reverse mode — 'if I only run 7 days, what can I detect'
Peeking simulator: with identical true rates in both arms, Monte Carlo runs four checking strategies to show the false-positive gap directly
Interpreter: p-value, CI and a three-tier plain-language verdict, then monthly incremental revenue at both CI bounds
projects.result: 全部计算在浏览器完成，不上传数据。校验脚本确认「每日偷看」策略的假阳性率为 22.45%，与理论值一致。这是一个演示统计常识的工具，不是统计库。
projects.resultEn: Everything runs in the browser; nothing is uploaded. The validation script confirms a 22.45% false-positive rate for daily peeking, matching theory. It demonstrates statistical common sense; it is not a statistics library.

projects.name: Pricing Model Sim
projects.subtitle: 给一条留存曲线，算出单次解锁、包月订阅、混合三种付费机制 12 个月的 ARPU、LTV 与回本周期
projects.subtitleEn: Given a retention curve, compute 12-month ARPU, LTV and payback for pay-per-unlock, subscription and hybrid pricing
projects.description: 付费机制模拟器。拖一条留存曲线、调几个价格参数，看三种机制的 LTV 曲线在哪个参数上换手。敏感性分析可以扫一遍月费或免费集数，找到最优机制的切换点。
projects.descriptionEn: A pricing-mechanism simulator. Drag a retention curve, tune a few price parameters, and see where the three LTV curves cross. Sensitivity analysis sweeps monthly fee or free episodes to find the switch-over point.
projects.context: 做海外短剧付费时遇到过收入下滑。团队的第一反应是加大买量，但问题未必在获客，也可能在付费机制——包月订阅市场的复购率比单集解锁市场高三倍多。最花时间的不是分析，是说服：要让所有人看见同一批用户换个付费机制，12 个月能差出多少收入。Excel 能算一两组参数，但要扫一遍「月费 25 到 40、免费集数 0 到 15」找换手点，手算做不到。
projects.contextEn: Revenue fell on an overseas short-drama product. The reflex was to buy more traffic, but the issue may sit in the pricing mechanism — subscription markets had over 3x the repurchase rate of pay-per-episode markets. The time sink was persuasion, not analysis: everyone needed to see how much 12-month revenue differs for the same users under a different mechanism. Excel handles a couple of parameter sets; sweeping fee 25–40 and free episodes 0–15 to find the crossover does not work by hand.
approach: 留存曲线：拖 D1 / D7 / D30 / D90 / D180 五个锚点实时重拟合，或选短剧、工具、社交三类预设
三机制对比：调参数看 LTV 与回本月份，结论卡直接说明谁更优、为什么
敏感性分析：选一个参数（月费、免费集数、订阅转化率、切换摩擦、CAC、付费率）扫一遍，标出最优机制的换手点
approachEn: Retention curve: drag five anchors (D1 / D7 / D30 / D90 / D180) with live refit, or pick a preset for drama, tools or social
Mechanism comparison: tune parameters, read LTV and payback month, with a verdict card stating which wins and why
Sensitivity: sweep one parameter (fee, free episodes, sub conversion, switching friction, CAC, pay rate) and mark the switch-over point
projects.result: 附手算校验与守恒检查脚本，4 个合成案例可一键载入。它回答的是「该选哪种机制」，不做定价寻优，也不接真实数据。
projects.resultEn: Ships with hand-calculation and conservation checks; four synthetic cases load in one click. It answers 'which mechanism' — it does not optimise price or connect to real data.

projects.name: Bundle Lab
projects.subtitle: 从订单里找出值得做成套餐的商品组合，并把收益边界算清楚
projects.subtitleEn: Find product combinations worth bundling from order data, and quantify the profit boundary
projects.description: 套餐机会发现器。传一份订单明细，看多人订单与单人订单的错位，挖出经常一起买的组合，调折扣与采纳率看客单和毛利的变化，导出「推给谁、推什么、什么情况别推」的建议。附校验脚本回答挖出的组合是不是噪声。
projects.descriptionEn: A bundle-opportunity finder. Upload order lines, see where group orders and single orders diverge, surface frequently co-bought combinations, tune discount and adoption to watch basket size and margin move, then export a who / what / when-not-to recommendation. Validation scripts check whether the findings are noise.
projects.context: 在美团沙特市场做用户增长时发现，客单价低不是用户不想多买，而是商品结构与点单结构错位：很多是多人点单，但菜单以单人餐为主，凑不成套就放弃。后来推了家庭套餐专区。那次分析大部分靠人工拉 SQL 再拍脑袋定组合，定完也说不清为什么是这几个组合、打几折不亏。
projects.contextEn: Working on growth for Meituan's Saudi market, low basket size turned out to be a mismatch between menu and ordering: many orders were for groups, yet the menu was built around single meals, so people gave up. A family-bundle section followed. That analysis was mostly hand-written SQL and gut-feel combos, with no clear answer to why these combos or what discount stays profitable.
approach: 订单画像：对比多人订单与单人订单的商品分布，定位错位
组合发现：从共现频次挖出「经常一起买」的组合，附召回校验（植入已知组合看能否被找回）
收益推演：调折扣与采纳率，输出客单、毛利变化与盈亏平衡采纳率
approachEn: Order profile: compare item mix between group and single orders to locate the mismatch
Combo discovery: surface frequently co-bought sets from co-occurrence, with a recall check (plant known combos, see if they come back)
Profit projection: tune discount and adoption, output basket, margin and break-even adoption
projects.result: 目标用户是没有算法团队的中小电商与餐饮运营——会看表格，不会写 SQL。全部计算在浏览器端。它是分析工具，不接平台 API、不做在线推荐、不做库存。
projects.resultEn: Built for small e-commerce and F&B operators without a data team — people who read spreadsheets but do not write SQL. Runs entirely in the browser. It is an analysis tool: no platform API, no live recommendation, no inventory.

projects.name: 留学咨询内容矩阵
projects.description: MCN 模式搭建 40+ 垂类账号矩阵，签约 50+ KOL，总粉丝量破 10 万+，月均获取高意向线索超 100 条，CPL 降低 30%。
projects.descriptionEn: MCN-style content matrix with 40+ accounts, 50+ KOLs, 100k+ followers, 100+ qualified leads/month, 30% CPL reduction.
projects.subtitle: 两年，40+ 账号，把线索成本打下来 30%
projects.subtitleEn: Two years, 40+ accounts, 30% lower cost per lead
projects.context: 留学咨询靠投流获客越来越贵，内容自然流量是唯一能复用的资产。
projects.contextEn: Paid acquisition in study-abroad consulting kept getting more expensive; organic content was the only reusable asset.
approach: 按国家、专业、预算切垂类账号，而不是做一个大号 —— 垂类越窄，线索意向越高
签约 50+ KOL 做分发，自己只保留选题与转化链路
approachEn: Built narrow vertical accounts by country / major / budget instead of one large account — narrower niche, higher lead intent
Signed 50+ KOLs for distribution, keeping topic selection and the conversion path in-house
projects.result: 40+ 账号、10 万+ 粉丝，月均 100+ 高意向线索，CPL -30%。

language: 英语（五年英国学习与工作）

about.lead: 张千羽，做 AI 产品。
about.leadEn: Andy Zhang. I work on AI products.
about.body: 本科在布里斯托读电子电气工程，硕士在 UCL 读计算金融。两段专业教的东西相近：怎么把一个模糊的问题变成能算的问题。读完之后去做产品，是因为我更关心用户的行为——他们为什么这样用、为什么不这样用。
about.bodyEn: I studied Electronic & Electrical Engineering at Bristol and Computational Finance at UCL. Both taught roughly the same skill: turning a vague question into one you can compute. I went into product because I care more about how people actually behave — why they use something one way and not another.
about.body2: 目前主要做两件事：一是给模型效果建评估体系，让「好不好」有一个能复核的标准；二是做用户增长，从数据里找问题、用实验验证判断。
about.body2En: Two things take most of my time now: building evaluation systems so that 'is this model good' has a reviewable answer, and growth work — finding problems in data and testing judgements with experiments.

principles.dz: 多数做不下去的需求，是因为一开始没说清要解决什么。我习惯先把问题写成一句话，写不出来就说明还没想明白。
principles.de: Most stalled requests were never clearly stated. I write the problem as one sentence first; if I cannot, it is not ready.

principles.en: A metric needs a failure condition
principles.dz: 定指标的时候同时定清楚：什么情况算没达到。没有失败条件的指标只是装饰。
principles.de: When setting a metric, also define what counts as missing it. A metric without a failure condition is decoration.

principles.en: Do it yourself when you can
principles.dz: 写需求之前先把流程亲自走一遍。这个网站和几个评测工具都是自己写的，不是为了炫技，是为了确认自己真的理解。
principles.de: Before writing a spec, walk the flow myself. This site and the eval tools are hand-built — not to show off, but to make sure I actually understand.

items.zh: 几个开源的评测和增长工具：creative-eval、filing-eval、growth-experiment-lab、pricing-model-sim、bundle-lab。每个都有可点开的 demo。
items.en: A set of open-source eval and growth tools — creative-eval, filing-eval, growth-experiment-lab, pricing-model-sim, bundle-lab. Each has a live demo.

items.zh: 离线评测跑出来的分数，怎样才能在线上被信任。评测体系和产品决策之间那一段，现在是空的。
items.en: How offline eval scores earn trust in production. The gap between an eval system and a product decision is still mostly empty.

items.zh: 德州扑克。位置、范围、下注尺度。做那个玩家类型测试也是从牌桌上来的。
items.en: Texas Hold'em — position, ranges, sizing. The player-type quiz came from the table.

colophon.zh: 这个站是手写的：一个 index.html、一个 style.css、一个 app.js，加一份 data.json 当数据层。没有框架、没有构建步骤、没有依赖——改一行字就是改一行字。四个配色主题是真的四套 CSS 变量，不是滤镜。
colophon.en: This site is hand-written: one index.html, one style.css, one app.js, plus a data.json as the data layer. No framework, no build step, no dependencies — a text change is a text change. The four themes are four real sets of CSS variables, not a filter.
colophon.zh2: 字体用了 Inter / Noto Serif SC / JetBrains Mono。动画尽量用 CSS 而不是 JS，能省一帧是一帧。
colophon.en2: Type is set in Inter, Noto Serif SC and JetBrains Mono. Animations prefer CSS over JS — one frame saved is one frame saved.
